title: "Resources"

## Careers in statistics

A 12-page brochure (PDF) about careers in statistics. It tells what statistics is, who should become a statistician, and which fields employ statisticians. It also gives contact details for universities.

## Statistical terms

A list of approximately 7200 statistical terms, for statisticians, translators and the public.

## glosario

An open source glossary of terms in statistics and data science, in English, Afrikaans, isiXhosa and more.
